vsfluidlink.configuration.title: %s Settings
vsfluidlink.configuration.connectWithout: Right-click manual connectors with an empty hand or non-wrench item to connect or disconnect. Sneaking bypasses linking for normal item use. Magnets remain automatic.
vsfluidlink.configuration.wrenchRightCli: ROTATE (default): right-click rotates, sneak-right-click picks up. CONNECT (legacy): right-click connects/disconnects, sneak-right-click rotates. Magnet connectors cannot be manually linked.
vsfluidlink.configuration.magnetMaxConne: Maximum facing misalignment from directly opposing, shared by all magnets. Not the angle to the line between blocks. Connection requires an angle below this value.
vsfluidlink.configuration.magnetDisconne: Fluid, item and electric magnets disconnect above this misalignment. Set higher than the connection angle to prevent repeated reconnection.
vsfluidlink.configuration.magnetChainDis: Chain magnets disconnect above this misalignment. Set higher than the connection angle to prevent repeated reconnection.
vsfluidlink.configuration.restrictIntraS: Block Connections Within One Ship or Sub-Level
item.vsfluidlink.hose_connector.tooltip:
Makes fluid transport between ships easier. 
Right-click two connectors to link them. 
Required item depends on server interaction settings.
item.vsfluidlink.magnet_hose_connector.t:
Automatically connects to another connector in front. 
Connection is disabled by redstone signal.
item.vsfluidlink.item_hose_connector.too:
Makes item transport between ships easier. 
Right-click two connectors to link them. 
Required item depends on server interaction settings. 
Requires rotational power (32+ RPM) to operate.
item.vsfluidlink.item_magnet_hose_connec:
Automatically connects to another connector in front. 
Connection is disabled by redstone signal. 
Requires rotational power (32+ RPM) to operate.
item.vsfluidlink.electric_wire_connector:
Makes energy (FE) transport between ships easier. 
Right-click two connectors to link them. 
Required item depends on server interaction settings.
item.vsfluidlink.electric_magnet_wire_co:
Automatically connects to another connector in front. 
Connection is disabled by redstone signal.
item.vsfluidlink.chain_connector.tooltip:
Makes rotational power transport between ships easier. 
Right-click two connectors to link them. 
Required item depends on server interaction settings.
Automatically connects to another connector in front. 
Connection is disabled by redstone signal.
vsfluidlink.message.world_to_world_restr: Connection between world blocks is restricted by config.
vsfluidlink.message.intra_ship_restricte: Connection within the same ship is restricted by config.
